description: This EPA page is a register of state and local studies and data about materials, waste and recycling in the United States, maintained alongside EPA's national Facts and Figures about Materials, Waste and Recycling. It lists waste characterisation studies by state and some cities, linking to the reports that measure the composition of municipal solid waste sent to disposal, and to state measurement programmes that track generation, recycling and disposal tonnages, although reports are not available for every state. It supports EPA's State Data Measurement Sharing Program, which aims to make state waste data more consistent. Coverage is the states and localities that have published studies, with years varying from the 2000s to recent studies. The page and linked reports are free. Caveats: studies use different sampling methods, material categories and years, so they cannot simply be combined, and several links point to state websites that change. Simulation uses: finding local waste composition and tonnage data to parameterise collection, recycling and landfill models for US states and cities. Related records: CalRecycle waste characterisation (data-calrecycle-waste-characterization) is one of the state studies it links, and the EPA recycling infrastructure map (data-epa-recycling-infrastructure-market-opportunities-map) shows facilities.
